input.label: feature
input.reply:
Thanks for the suggestion. This is a request to change how `headless: true` behaves with the Playwright provider, so I'm treating it as a feature request.

Your `launchOptions: { args: ["--headless=new"] }` workaround is a good one to document for now. Note that it requires `browser.headless` to stay unset, as you mentioned.

I could not search existing issues or the source from here, so I haven't confirmed whether a similar request already exists. A maintainer should check that, and also decide whether the new mode should be the default or opt-in. Making it the default could change behavior for users on older Playwright versions or with the headless shell installed, so version gating would need care.

Your offer to open a PR is welcome. Please wait for maintainer agreement on the approach before investing time in it.
